newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Gajah Tunggal rights issue approved.
newsitem.headline: Gajah Tunggal rights issue approved.

text.p: Shareholders of Indonesia's largest tyre manufacturer PT Gajah Tunggal on Tuesday approved a one-for-one rights issue which will help it maintain a majority stake in subsidiary tyre cord firm PT Andayani Megah.

An extraordinary general body meeting of the company approved the issue of 792 million new shares, which will be offered to shareholders as of September 30, 1996, at a price of 1,000 rupiah per share.

The company has previously said 51 percent of the net proceeds of 784 billion rupiah will be used to maintain its majority shareholding in Andayani Megah, which is launching a separate rights issue to expand into the chemicals and polymer sector.

Twenty nine percent of the proceeds, or about 226 billion rupiah, will be used to invest in a power generation project to supply power to the company, while the rest will be used for other activites and to boost working capital.
